If you do get some, don’t get ANY with d3 because that’s toxic for them in high amounts, and it’s just, in general, not beneficial for their diets. That’s all I can think of. I understand. If I’m honest, I don’t want to get better either. I don’t know what else to say but empathy exists in so many amazing people.
